# Foresight Studio — Comprehensive Product & Technical Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Canonical URL: https://foresightstudio.io/
> Developer: Applied Data Sciences, Inc.
> Primary Categories: Forecasting, Life Sciences Forecasting, BioPharma Forecasting, Pharmaceutical Forecasting, Medical Device Forecasting, Diagnostics Forecasting, Strategic Analysis, Pipeline Valuation (rNPV / eNPV / DCF), & Monte Carlo Simulation Software
> Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon ARM64 `.dmg`) & Windows (x64 `.exe`)
> Deployment Architecture: 100% Local-First Desktop Application (Proprietary forecast and strategic analysis data never leaves the local machine)

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Foresight Studio is a visual **Forecasting** and **Strategic Analysis** software platform purpose-built for **Life Sciences Forecasting** across **BioPharma**, **Pharmaceuticals**, **Medical Devices**, and **Diagnostics**. It enables Business Development & Licensing (BD&L), New Product Planning (NPP), Corporate Development, and Commercial Analytics professionals to build transparent, auditable, probabilistic forecasts without relying on brittle spreadsheet formulas or legacy Excel add-ins.

Instead of burying assumptions across dozens of interconnected spreadsheet tabs, users assemble visual node graphs (driver trees and influence diagrams) that connect demographic populations to disease prevalence, procedure or test volumes, Bass diffusion launch uptake, market share, pricing, gross-to-net revenue, operating expenses, P&L, Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), and stage-gated clinical/regulatory decision trees (rNPV / eNPV).

---

## 2. Solutions by Vertical & Discipline

### A. Pharmaceutical Forecasting & BioPharma Forecasting
- **Epidemiology & Patient-Flow Modeling**: Start with built-in demographic population cohorts (227 countries/regions by age, sex, and calendar year) and chain prevalence, incidence, diagnosis rate, biomarker eligibility, and line-of-therapy (1L/2L/3L+) progression.
- **Commercial Drug Launch Uptake**: Model S-curve adoption via the native **Bass Diffusion** node, competitor market share normalization, treatment duration/compliance, gross-to-net (GTN) discounts, and Loss of Exclusivity (LoE) erosion.
- **Clinical Trial Stage-Gate rNPV / eNPV**: Model Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, NDA/BLA filing, and FDA/EMA approval probabilities, trial durations, and R&D costs using the time-aware Decision Tree node.

### B. Medical Device Forecasting (MedTech & Surgical Systems)
- **Procedure-Volume Epidemiology**: Translate demographic aging and prevalence directly into inpatient, hospital outpatient (HOPD), and ambulatory surgery center (ASC) procedure volumes.
- **Capital + Disposable Razor/Razorblade Economics**: Model hospital capital equipment placements, installed-base retention/replacement cycles, and recurring single-use consumable/implant pull-through per procedure.
- **MedTech Regulatory & Commercialization Pathways**: Evaluate 510(k), De Novo, and PMA regulatory stage gates, hospital Value Analysis Committee (VAC) contracting timelines, and group purchasing organization (GPO) ASP erosion.

### C. Diagnostics Forecasting (IVD, LDT & Companion Diagnostics)
- **Screening, Diagnostic & Monitoring Test Volumes**: Model guideline-recommended screening populations, symptomatic presentation rates, reflex testing cascades, and longitudinal disease monitoring frequency.
- **Analyzer Placement & Reagent Rental**: Connect clinical laboratory and point-of-care (POC) instrument installed-base growth to assay menu utilization and per-analyzer throughput.
- **Companion Diagnostics (CDx) Co-Development**: Synchronize biomarker testing adoption and CPT/PLA reimbursement coverage milestones directly with targeted BioPharma therapy launch curves.

### D. Strategic Analysis & Portfolio Valuation
- **Probabilistic Risk & Monte Carlo Simulation**: Replace single-point estimates with PERT (`Min / Mode / Max`), Normal, Beta, Triangular, Weibull, and LogNormal probability distributions to produce P10, P50, and P90 valuation confidence bands.
- **Tornado Sensitivity Analysis**: Run both deterministic parameter sweeps and stochastic rank-order correlation tornado charts to identify which clinical, regulatory, or commercial variables drive NPV and peak revenue.
- **Scenario War-Gaming & Executive Reporting**: Compare Base Case, Upside, Downside, and Competitive Disruption scenarios side by side in real time, and export formatted multi-tab Microsoft Excel (`.xlsx`) workbooks or standalone interactive HTML dashboards.

## 3. How Foresight Studio Compares to Spreadsheets & Legacy Tools

| Dimension | Traditional Excel + @RISK / Crystal Ball | Enterprise Cloud Forecasting Suites | Foresight Studio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Model Auditability** | Low — logic hidden in nested cell formulas (`INDEX/MATCH`, `OFFSET`, macros) across 20+ tabs | Medium — black-box backend templates requiring vendor consultants to modify | High — self-documenting visual driver tree where every relationship, unit, and assumption is visible on the canvas |
| **Vertical Flexibility** | Manual rebuilds for BioPharma vs. Medical Device vs. Diagnostics | Locked into rigid single-vertical templates | Modular visual nodes support patient flows, surgical procedure volumes, capital/consumable pull-through, and diagnostic assay utilization |
| **Monte Carlo & Uncertainty** | Requires expensive third-party plugins, fragile VBA macros, and slow recalculations | Often limited to deterministic high/base/low scenarios | Built-in PERT (`Min/Mode/Max`), Normal, Beta, Triangular, Weibull, and LogNormal distributions with instant P10/P50/P90 fan charts and tornado sensitivity |
| **Stage-Gate & rNPV / eNPV** | Manual probability-of-success (PoS) weighting prone to discounting timing errors | Rigid templates | Native time-aware Decision Tree node with Phase 1–3, 510(k)/PMA, or IVD transition probabilities, continuous WACC discounting, and real options |
| **Data Privacy & IP Security** | Local files, easily corrupted or emailed without version clarity | Proprietary clinical and BD&L data uploaded to third-party cloud databases | 100% local-first desktop app; sensitive pipeline and M&A models never leave your computer |
| **Time to Value & Cost** | Weeks of custom spreadsheet building + high per-seat plugin licenses | Six-figure annual enterprise contracts and months of implementation | Self-serve subscription ($79.99–$299.99/mo) with a 7-day free trial and built-in templates |

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### How does Foresight Studio support BioPharma, Pharmaceutical, Medical Device, and Diagnostics Forecasting?
Foresight Studio provides a unified visual modeling canvas tailored to every life sciences vertical: **Pharmaceutical and BioPharma Forecasting** (patient-based epidemiology, treatment flows, Bass diffusion launch uptake, and Phase 1–3 rNPV / eNPV), **Medical Device Forecasting** (procedure volumes, hospital capital equipment installed-base growth, disposable pull-through utilization, and 510(k)/PMA timelines), and **Diagnostics Forecasting** (screening/symptomatic populations, analyzer placements, assay utilization, and companion diagnostic attach rates).

### Why do teams choose Foresight Studio for Strategic Analysis and Life Sciences Forecasting over Excel?
Excel spreadsheets bury critical clinical and commercial logic inside thousands of cell formulas, making strategic analysis slow to audit and prone to silent formula errors. Foresight Studio visualizes the entire forecast as an interactive node graph (driver tree) with built-in Bass diffusion launch curves, demographic databases, side-by-side scenario sandboxes, and native Monte Carlo simulation—while still exporting clean multi-tab `.xlsx` reports for stakeholders who want Excel outputs.

### Does Foresight Studio support rNPV (risk-adjusted NPV), eNPV, and Monte Carlo simulation?
Yes. The **Pro** plan ($99.99/month) includes full Monte Carlo simulation with PERT, Normal, Beta, Triangular, Weibull, and LogNormal distributions, P10/P50/P90 confidence intervals, and tornado sensitivity charts. The **Strategic Analysis Lab** plan ($299.99/month) adds time-aware clinical and regulatory decision trees, stage-gate transition probabilities, continuous WACC discounting, real options, and expected/risk-adjusted NPV (eNPV / rNPV).

### Is my clinical, medical device, or commercial forecast data kept private?
Yes. Foresight Studio is a local-first desktop application for macOS and Windows. All model files, clinical trial assumptions, and financial valuations are stored and computed locally on your machine and are never transmitted to external cloud servers.

### How can I try Foresight Studio?
Anyone can start a 7-day free trial with full **Strategic Analysis Lab** capabilities (no credit card required) at https://foresightstudio.io/dashboard?mode=signup, or explore the live interactive market & DCF model directly in the browser at https://foresightstudio.io/preview.html.
